issue.title: Ctrl+J/K section jumps target cabinet-absorbed catalog H2s without reveal (possible invisible cursor in Live Preview)

task_type_fields.impact: If confirmed, a Vim user on any area, project, or album note can land on an invisible or ambiguous cursor with Ctrl+J/K, which breaks the cabinets 'no invisible cursor' invariant through a navigation path neither epic tested.
task_type_fields.repro:
Found by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent's integration review; not yet reproduced in real
Obsidian.

Since cabinets went live (bob-plugins 64268af9), Live Preview hides each claimed
catalog's `## Areas` / `## Projects` / `## Notebooks` / `## Albums` / `## Records` H2
plus its callout through a block `Decoration.replace` with `EditorView.atomicRanges`
(`plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/240wg-plugin-cabinet-absorb-editor.js`). The cabinets
contract says heading navigation (`[[note#Projects]]`, the Outline pane, `#Records`)
calls the claim's `reveal()`, and that no motion may leave an invisible cursor.

bob-navigation-hotkeys' `Ctrl+J` / `Ctrl+K` section jump
(`src/613-plugin-section-jump.js` `jumpToSectionHeader`) scans raw editor lines
(`getSectionMapHeadingEntries` / `getSectionHeadingEntries`) and puts the cursor on the
target heading line. It never consults the absorption field. It can therefore target an
absorbed H2 and park the cursor at the hidden range's start, a boundary contact, which
never reveals. The new Section Map (bob-cli-rc) also lists those hidden headings.
bob-cli-rc's plan deliberately puts "headings hidden by decorations" out of scope, and
the cabinets plan never covered Ctrl+J/K.

Repro to run first: on an area note with child catalogs, in Live Preview with cabinets
live, press Ctrl+J from the card body until the next target is an absorbed `## Areas`.
Check whether the cursor is visible, what the next j/k does, and whether the Section Map
row lands anywhere sensible.

Then decide: skip absorbed headings in the scanner (needs a read-only ledger-tools api
the nav plugin can query), or call the claim's `reveal()` (open the cabinet and scroll
its header) the way link navigation does.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent while reviewing post-epic integration with the Section Map work: the Ctrl+J/K section jump ignores cabinet absorption and neither epic covered the interaction.
